english.title: Fail to give assistance / information to a person acting in execution of Food (Promotion and Placement) England Regs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable cause, failed to give to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in the execution of the Food (Promotion and Placement) (England) Regulations 2021, the assistance or information which that person reasonably required of you for the performance of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

functions under the regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16(2)(f) and (i) of the Food (Promotion and Placement) (England) Regulations 2021 and sections 33(1)(b) and 35(1) of the Food Safety Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum three months imprisonment and / or a fine.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limits for Prosecutions:
6 months
